title: fix(app-shell): write a served view's toolbar change inside `config` so it survives reload (objectui#11625)
body:
Fixes #11625

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`buildPersistedViewBody` builds the body `persistViewPatch` sends through `updateViewConfig` when a grid toolbar control changes. It now writes the patch inside `config` when the active tab carries the stored ViewItem envelope `{ name, object, viewKind, config }`:

- A patch key that `ListViewSchema` declares goes into `config`: `rowHeight`, `sort`, `hiddenFields` or `inlineEdit`. The key set is read off the spec schema, the same derivation `buildViewConfigSaveBody` uses. A stale copy of that key on the envelope is removed, so the request carries the key once, in the place the door keeps.
- Any other key stays on the envelope: `columnState`, plus the row state the envelope already carries (`isDefault`, `isPinned`, `sortOrder`, `visibility`), which is never moved. This is the objectui#11013 fence.
- A flat base (no `config`) still gets the flat spread. The overlay branch (`isSavedView: false`) is unchanged.

The server side is untouched. The door still drops undeclared envelope keys, which triage (`5986778563`) keeps as designed. Nothing changes on the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry: `buildPersistedViewBody` is exported from `ObjectView.tsx`, not from the package.

## Measured live, before and after

Stack: the console from this worktree (Vite, workspace `src` aliases) against objectstack `main` `045f764c`, showcase app, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, admin session. Each row is one toolbar action in Chromium. I captured the `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/NAME` body and answer in the browser, read the row back with `GET /api/v1/meta/view/NAME`, and then reloaded in a fresh browser context. "Before" ran this branch with `ObjectView.tsx` checked out at the base `1c2e2c4`. "After" ran the fix on a new `--fresh` database.

| Path | Before: PUT, stored row, reload | After: PUT, stored row, reload |
|---|---|---|
| Stock `showcase_task.default`, density | `rowHeight: "medium"` beside `config`. Answer `200` "Saved customization overlay". Stored row has no `rowHeight`, either top-level or in `config`. Reload shows "Density: Compact". | `config.rowHeight: "medium"`, no top-level copy, `200`. Stored row has `config.rowHeight: "medium"`. Reload shows "Density: Comfortable" with 45 px rows. |
| Stock `showcase_task.grid`, density | Same loss as the row above. | `config.rowHeight: "medium"` stored. Reload shows Comfortable, 41 px rows before and 45 px after. |
| User-created `showcase_task.my_tasks`, density | Same loss. | `config.rowHeight: "medium"` stored. Reload shows Comfortable, 45 px. |
| Stock `showcase_task.default`, column-header sort on Title | Top-level `sort`, `200`. Stored row has no `sort`. | `config.sort` stored as `[{ field: "title", order: "asc" }]`; the door strips the console's row `id`. The reload's data request carries `sort=title`. |
| Stock `showcase_task.urgent`, hide-fields toggle, hiding Priority | Top-level `hiddenFields`, `200`. Stored row has no `hiddenFields`. Reload shows the Priority column again. | `config.hiddenFields: ["priority"]` stored. Reload shows no Priority column. |
| Post-merge `e7ed7fd`, stock `showcase_task.tabular`, density | not run | `config.rowHeight: "medium"` stored beside the view's declared `config.sort`, which is kept. Reload shows Comfortable, 45 px. |

The `my_tasks` row was created with the envelope "Add View" writes (`viewEnvelope`), PUT as active. On every showcase view the hide-fields toggle is off by default (`userActions.hideFields`). For `urgent` I turned it on with an envelope save carrying `config.userActions.hideFields: true`, the shape "Edit view config → Save" writes.

What the PM's mechanism assumptions measured:

- **Which branch.** Every stock list view and the user-created one take the saved branch. The before-PUT body is the whole served item and carries no `_isOverride`. The server serves each list view as a view item, so `listViews()` returns it and `isSavedViewId` answers true. The tab carries `config` because `MetadataProvider` merges every served view into `objectDef.listViews`, and `loadViewOverrides` lays the raw stored row over it.
- **The overlay branch's flat body is what the door keeps.** I put a marked flat overlay row on `showcase_task.done`. The density toggle there sent a flat `{ rowHeight: "tall", viewKind, object, name, _isOverride: true }` and got `200`. The read-back has a top-level `rowHeight: "tall"`, and the reload shows "Density: Spacious". This is identical before and after, so that branch needs no `config` and is left alone.
- **The card's control.** An envelope PUT with `config.rowHeight: "tall"` on `showcase_task.in_progress` reads back `config.rowHeight: "tall"`.
- **The fence.** In every saved-branch PUT and read-back, `isDefault` stayed on the envelope. The unit pins below cover the full row-state set and `columnState`.

## Tests

- **New: `ObjectView.densityInsideConfig-11625.test.ts`.**
  - It pins the body for each branch: an envelope-shaped saved row, a flat saved row and the overlay. It also pins the row-owned fence.
  - It runs a round trip through the real `ObjectStackAdapter` into a store whose `saveItem` judges every PUT with the spec's `ViewMetadataSchema` and keeps the parsed value, as the live door does. It then reads the row back through `listViews()`, `loadViewOverrides` and `buildViewTabs`.
  - The file includes a control: the pre-fix spread is accepted by that store and its density is dropped, so the store is shown to discriminate.
- **Ratchet change in `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly.test.ts`.** This is the saved-view describe, two cases. Their `SAVED_TAB` carries a `config`. The live door was measured stripping a top-level patch key from exactly that shape, so the two assertions that pinned the patch at the top level pinned the defect.
  - `carries the whole body` now asserts that `body.config` equals the row's `config` plus the sort, and that the body has no top-level `sort`.
  - `leaves its definition intact at rest` now asserts that the stored `config` equals the row's `config` plus `rowHeight`, and that the row has no top-level `rowHeight`.
  - Every other assertion in both cases stands: `columns`, `filter`, `label`, and the withheld `_isOverride`. The overlay-branch cases and both source ratchets are untouched. Each changed case gains an absence assertion, so the cases are tighter than before, not looser.
- **Run at `0113970`, before the merge.**
  - The four files that pin `buildPersistedViewBody` or its writes passed: `pnpm exec vitest run` over `ObjectView.densityInsideConfig-11625.test.ts`, `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly.test.ts`, `InterfaceListPage.hollowOverlayHydration.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.emptyColumnsNoProjection-10694.test.tsx` gave `Test Files 4 passed (4)` and `Tests 40 passed (40)`.
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` gave `Test Files 1001 passed | 1 skipped (1002)` and `Tests 9940 passed | 9 skipped (9949)`, exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` exited 0 with 0 errors.
- **Root gates.** Each was run before the merge and again on the merged head, exit 0 every time: `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- **NOT MEASURED when this PR was opened. The results go in the `os-dev-report` comment on the card.** All of these are queued under the shared verify lock behind another seat's run:
  - type-check: `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`. The plain `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exited 2 on `TS2307` (cannot find `@object-ui/components` and the other dependencies), because the worktree had none of the dependency `dist/` built. That is an unmet prerequisite, not a reading on this diff.
  - the one-shot ablation: the pre-fix saved-branch spread put back through `ablation-replace.mjs`, the two pin files run, then restored.
  - the post-merge rerun of the targeted files, lint and the app-shell suite.

## Acceptance notes

- **Still open, measured, and not changed here.** Within one page session, a second toolbar change to the same view overwrites the first. Example on `showcase_task.in_progress`: change density, wait past the debounce, then sort by header. The second PUT's `config` carries the sort but not the density, because every save is a whole-document PUT built from the tab as it was at page load. After a reload only the sort is left. The overlay branch does the same: on `showcase_task.done`, the second PUT `{ sort, … }` replaces the `{ rowHeight, … }` row. This predates this change and affects every kind of row. It is reported to the seat with the reproduction, not fixed here: the right shape (accumulate written patches in the session, re-read after a write, or read-modify-write in the adapter) is not pinned. The changeset says it plainly.
- **The overlay branch's only console-reached path today is refused.** On an object with no list views (`showcase_account`), the density toggle sends `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/all` with the fallback tab's id `all` and no `viewKind`. The door answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` (container branch, "Unrecognized key(s) on this view container: `rowHeight`, `_isOverride`"). Reported to the seat, not touched.
- **A marked flat overlay row on a served view takes that view's place on read.** After the `showcase_task.done` overlay above, `GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.done` returns the overlay with no `config`, `columns` or `filter`. The console then loads the Done view without its `status = done` filter. From a clean state the console does not originate such a row, since every served list view is classed saved. Reported to the seat with the measurement.
- `inlineEdit` is routed by the same rule and unit-pinned. Its live toggle was not driven, so that is NOT MEASURED. The same holds for a live `columnState` drag.
